name: Gadroon
description: Gadrooning: a band of short convex lobes, leaning off the vertical.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 24%; width: 100%; height: 52%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 46%, transparent 46% 50%) 0 0 / 16.6% 100%; mask: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 0 46%, transparent 46% 50%) 0 0 / 16.6% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-12deg, 0deg, 12deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-12deg, 0deg, 12deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
